note: One line per appearance, published as the catalog entry's description. Keyed by the appearance id a saved setting stores, which is the style in the package manifest. Kept beside the catalog rather than inside the packages: a package is megabytes of artwork, and correcting a sentence should not put every installation through a download. tools/build-skin-catalog.ps1 refuses to build without an entry here, so a new appearance cannot reach the catalog without one.

deepseek.zh: 深蓝长发的小鲸鱼，戴着白色水手帽，安静地守在桌面一角。
deepseek.en: A deep-blue whale girl in a white sailor cap, keeping quiet watch from a corner of the desktop.

chatgpt.zh: 银白长发的小白龙，头上一对小角，神情干净利落。
chatgpt.en: A silver-white dragon girl with a pair of small horns and an unruffled look.

minimax.zh: 橙发卷毛的小海螺，戴着白色贝雷帽，手里握着一支话筒。
minimax.en: An orange-haired conch girl in a white beret, microphone in hand.

gemini.zh: 紫发小星猫，一对猫耳，发间别着一颗星。
gemini.en: A purple star cat with cat ears and a star pinned in her hair.

grok.zh: 金发双马尾的小恶魔，黑角黑翼，笑得张扬。
grok.en: A blonde twin-tailed little demon with black horns and wings, grinning wide.

claude.zh: 橙发小书灵，怀里总抱着一本书。
claude.en: An orange-haired book spirit who is always holding a book.

kimi.zh: 银白卷发的小棱镜，系着蓝色蝴蝶结。
kimi.en: A silver-curled little prism with a blue ribbon.

qwen.zh: 青蓝长发的小折扇，手里握着一把折扇。
qwen.en: A blue-green little folding fan, with a fan in her hand.

ernie.zh: 紫发小病书灵，坐在轮椅上，身边带着书和输液架。
ernie.en: A purple book spirit who is unwell, in a wheelchair with a book and a drip stand.

glm.zh: 黑发小方灵，戴着白色蕾丝头饰。
glm.en: A black-haired little square spirit in a white lace headdress.

gpt-image2.en: An ink dragon with black hair, gold eyes and a pair of dark horns.

llama.zh: 奶白色的小羊驼，毛茸茸的耳朵，看起来还没睡醒。
llama.en: A cream-coloured alpaca with fluffy ears who looks only half awake.

mimo.zh: 银白长发的小兔码师，戴着兔耳发箍。
mimo.en: A silver-haired bunny coder wearing a rabbit-ear headband.

opencode.zh: 黑长直发的小码灵，头顶一对机械猫耳。

perplexity.zh: 青绿长发的小探灯，戴着耳机，手里提着一盏灯。
perplexity.en: A teal-haired lantern bearer with headphones and a lamp in hand.

seedance.zh: 淡紫渐变长发的小星晶，发梢卷起一缕青色。
seedance.en: A star crystal with lavender gradient hair and a curl of cyan at the tips.
